sources.title: Recruiters' perceptions and use of applicant resume information: Screening the recent graduate

concepts.definition: A resume line that states what you did, how much and with what result.

questions.q: Rewrite "Responsible for onboarding" into an action-scope-result line.
questions.a: For example: Onboarded 6 new hires in 2 months with a checklist that cut questions to the manager.

questions.q: What three parts does a short cover letter have?
questions.a: Why this employer, what you offer with evidence, and what you ask for.
